title: Nvidia prepares to push out CEO Jensen Huang, reports
summary: The board at chipmaker Nvidia is reportedly preparing to oust CEO Jensen Huang, according to US media reports. He has been accused of an affair with an alleged Chinese spy.

image.caption: Huang's potential ouster would leave a leadership vacuum at the roughly $4 trillion chipmaker he cofounded Image: Markus Schreiber/AP Photo/picture alliance

blocks.text: Nvidia's board prepared to oust co-founder and CEO Jensen Huang and could meet imminently to decide his future, media outlets reported on Wednesday.
Huang has led the company for more than three decades, turning it from a gaming chipmaker into the dominant supplier of chips for artificial intelligence.
The report sent Nvidia shares down about 8% in after-hours trading.

A reporter for the financial news outlet Bloomberg said on X that Nvidia's board was working with an outside firm to identify potential successors and considering an interim CEO while it searched for a permanent replacement.
More to come on this developing news
